CustomField.description: 仕様: Accounting 第9.1.1節。原因の事実を1列に出す。Goalの再計算ではない。
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(InvoiceLine__c), ISBLANK(JournalPatternKey__c), JournalPatternKey__c = "PAYMENT_NON_INVOICE_POSITIVE", JournalPatternKey__c = "PAYMENT_NON_INVOICE_NEGATIVE", NOT( OR( JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_INVOICE_BODY", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_INVOICE_BODY_CTA_TRANSFER", JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_TAX_AT_INVOICE", JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_INVOICE_TAX_DEFERRED", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_INVOICE_TAX_CTA_TRANSFER", JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_REVENUE_BODY", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_REVENUE_BODY", JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_REVENUE_TAX", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_REVENUE_TAX", JournalPatternKey__c = "PAYMENT_INVOICE_CURRENT", JournalPatternKey__c = "PAYMENT_INVOICE_HISTORICAL_POSITIVE_CASH", JournalPatternKey__c = "PAYMENT_INVOICE_HISTORICAL_NEGATIVE_CASH", JournalPatternKey__c = "PAYMENT_INVOICE_HISTORICAL_UAC_TRANSFER", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_INVOICE_BODY_CTA_TRANSFER", "明細税抜 ", "BILLING_BASIS_REVENUE_TAX", "明細税 ", "CASH_BASIS_REVENUE_TAX", "明細税 ", "BILLING_TAX_AT_INVOICE", "明細税 ", "BILLING_BASIS_INVOICE_TAX_DEFERRED", "明細税 ", "CASH_BASIS_INVOICE_TAX_CTA_TRANSFER", "明細税 ", "明細税込 " ) & IF( OR( JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_REVENUE_BODY", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_REVENUE_BODY", JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_INVOICE_BODY", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_INVOICE_BODY_CTA_TRANSFER" ), InvoiceLine__r.AmountCommaText__c, IF( OR( JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_REVENUE_TAX", "CASH_BASIS_INVOICE_TAX_CTA_TRANSFER" ), InvoiceLine__r.AllocatedTaxCommaText__c, InvoiceLine__r.TaxInclusiveCommaText__c ) ) & "円 " & TEXT(YEAR(InvoiceLine__r.ServicePeriodStartDate__c)) & "/" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MONTH(InvoiceLine__r.ServicePeriodStartDate__c)), 2) & "/" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(DAY(InvoiceLine__r.ServicePeriodStartDate__c)), 2) & "～" & TEXT(YEAR(InvoiceLine__r.ServicePeriodEndDate__c)) & "/" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MONTH(InvoiceLine__r.ServicePeriodEndDate__c)), 2) & "/" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(DAY(InvoiceLine__r.ServicePeriodEndDate__c)), 2) & " " & IF( OR( JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_REVENUE_BODY", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_REVENUE_BODY", JournalPatternKey__c = "BILLING_BASIS_REVENUE_TAX", JournalPatternKey__c = "CASH_BASIS_REVENUE_TAX" ), IF( ISPICKVAL(InvoiceLine__r.RevenueRecognitionBasis__c, "月次計上"), "月次計上で " & TEXT(FLOOR(RecognitionSequence__c)) & "/" & TEXT(FLOOR(InvoiceLine__r.RecognitionBucketCount__c)) & " 回目", "一括計上で検収日 " & TEXT(YEAR(InvoiceLine__r.AcceptanceEndDate__c)) & "/" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(MONTH(InvoiceLine__r.AcceptanceEndDate__c)), 2) & "/" & RIGHT("0" & TEXT(DAY(InvoiceLine__r.AcceptanceEndDate__c)), 2) ), TEXT(InvoiceLine__r.RevenueRecognitionBasis__c) ) )
